title: PRISM/AI — O: Observability
description: Production metrics, drift detectors, alert rules, AI incidents, and trace configurations for monitoring AI model and system behavior in production.

observability.description: Observability artifacts tracking production health of AI models and systems.

id.description: Unique identifier for this observability artifact.

type.description: What kind of observability artifact this is.

signal_type.description: The AI-specific signal this artifact measures or responds to.

threshold.description: The value at which an alert fires or an incident is declared.

aggregation.description: How signal data is aggregated before evaluation.

depends_on.description: IDs of model, system, or eval suite artifacts this observability artifact monitors.

current_value.description: Most recently observed value of this signal.

linked_guardrail.description: ID of the trust guardrail that this metric feeds or enforces.

resolution.description: For ai_incident: description of how the incident was resolved.

incident_date.description: For ai_incident: date the incident occurred.
